name: Roger L. Fosdick
research_summary: Fosdick studies thermodynamics, continuum mechanics, and nonlinear material behavior using applied mathematics. His work addresses both practical problems and the foundational theories describing energy, forces, and deformation in materials.

quiz.question: What field in Fosdick’s work concerns heat and energy?
What mechanics framework is listed in his research?
Does he study nonlinear material behavior?
choices: No, only perfectly linear springs in cartoons.

quiz.question: What tool does he use to analyze these problems?

choices: Both practical problems and foundational theory.
Neither; it is only a course title.
quiz.answer: Both practical problems and foundational theory.
